summary: Leading frontend architecture for a multi-role B2B commerce platform connecting manufacturers, distributors, dealers and retailers.
bullets: Led the **frontend architecture redesign** of a multi-role B2B platform serving distributors, dealers, retailers and manufacturers, supporting **4 distinct user roles** across a shared React.js codebase.

Led the design and development of a reusable **design system** and component architecture; built and standardized **30+ React.js components** to improve consistency, maintainability and development velocity.
Drove performance optimization and **reduced page-load time by ~30%** through lazy loading, code splitting and CDN caching, improving Core Web Vitals.
Integrated **AWS CloudFront** for optimized global content delivery and reduced asset latency for end users.
Managed **CI/CD pipelines** and deployment workflows with backend and DevOps teams, supporting reliable and scalable releases.
Implemented secure **JWT authentication and RBAC** across platform user types and workflows.
Strengthened frontend quality through **Jest-based testing**, unit testing, debugging and code-review practices.
Translated business requirements into production features while collaborating with product, backend and DevOps teams.
Used AI/GenAI tools and workflows to improve engineering productivity and accelerate development tasks.
